ColonyCouncil.ArcDef.label: the long way home
ColonyCouncil.ArcDef.summary: Days out on the road, someone at home is missed. Home again, the two of them sit up while the whole journey is told.

plain.li: {DAYS} days on the road now. I keep catching myself saving things up to tell {OTHER_nameDef}.
[partner] Slept on cold ground again. I miss the weight of {OTHER_nameDef}'s arm across me more than I'd say out loud.
[kin] Passed a farmhouse with washing on the line and thought of {OTHER_nameDef} straight away. Family does that to you.
[snow] The snow out here doesn't stop. I hope {OTHER_nameDef} is keeping the fire going at home.
Counted the days on my fingers this morning, then counted them again in case I'd got it wrong.

warm.li: Picked up a smooth gray stone on the road for {OTHER_nameDef}. It fits in a pocket. I'll give it over when I'm home.
[partner] Every evening I tell {OTHER_nameDef} about the day, out loud, to nobody in particular. The others have stopped teasing me about it.

blunt.li: Tired of walking. Tired of trail food. I want to be home, and I want {OTHER_nameDef} there when I get there.

cheerful.li: Saw a bird out here with a tail like a fan. {OTHER_nameDef} would have loved it. I'm practicing its call for when I get back!

gloomy.li: Too long away. Every night I picture something going wrong at home while I'm out here, and {OTHER_nameDef} facing it without me.

cold.li: The journey is useful. Still, I find I'm keeping count of the days until I see {OTHER_nameDef} again. Noted.

plain.li: {OTHER_nameDef} has been gone for days. The place is too quiet without {OTHER_objective}.
I keep looking down the road. No sign of {OTHER_nameDef} yet.
[partner] Slept on {OTHER_nameDef}'s side of the bed last night. It still smells of {OTHER_objective}.

gloomy.li: Every dust cloud on the road could be {OTHER_nameDef} coming home. None of them have been.

chronicle.li: {PAWN_nameDef} is far from home, and missing {OTHER_nameDef}.
Out on the road, {PAWN_nameDef} counts the days until {PAWN_pronoun} sees {OTHER_nameDef} again.

plain.li: Home. The gate, the smell of the cookfire, {OTHER_nameDef} at the door. I didn't trust it was real until I'd sat down.
[partner] {OTHER_nameDef} held on to me so long the others started unloading the animals around us.
Back, and my own bed tonight. I'll tell {OTHER_nameDef} everything tomorrow, once I've slept for a week.
[kin] {OTHER_nameDef} looked me over like I was a child back from the river, checking for scrapes. I let {OTHER_objective}.

warm.li: Home, and {OTHER_nameDef} had kept my place at the table the whole time I was gone.

blunt.li: Home. Finally. Nobody ask me to go anywhere for a while.

cheerful.li: Home! {OTHER_nameDef} saw me coming from halfway across the fields and ran the whole way.

gloomy.li: Back home, and it looks smaller than I remembered. {OTHER_nameDef} looks tired. I was gone too long.

cold.li: Returned. {OTHER_nameDef} was visibly relieved. I find I was too.

plain.li: {OTHER_nameDef} is home. Thinner, browner, and talking a lot. I don't mind.
{OTHER_nameDef} walked in as if {OTHER_pronoun}'d only been gone an afternoon. I'd been counting the days.
[partner] {OTHER_nameDef} came back to me. I'd got so used to worrying I didn't know what to do with my hands.

chronicle.li: {PAWN_nameDef} came home after {DAYS} days away, and {OTHER_nameDef} was waiting.
After {DAYS} days on the road, {PAWN_nameDef} is home again.

plain.li: Told {OTHER_nameDef} about the road last night: the river crossing, the trader with one ear, the night it hailed. We were up until the fire went out.
I've unpacked. My boots are by the door where they belong.
[partner] Fell asleep in the middle of the story about the pass, with {OTHER_nameDef} still listening. Woke up home.

warm.li: {OTHER_nameDef} listened to every word about the journey, even the dull parts. Especially those, I think.

blunt.li: Told {OTHER_nameDef} all of it. Done with traveling for a while.

cheerful.li: Acted out the whole journey for {OTHER_nameDef}, river crossing and all. I used a bowl for the boat!

gloomy.li: I'm home, and {OTHER_nameDef} is glad. I keep waiting for the next time someone has to go.

cold.li: Gave {OTHER_nameDef} an account of the journey. It was more pleasant than a report has any right to be.

plain.li: {OTHER_nameDef} told me about the road, every mile of it. I didn't want it to end.
[partner] {OTHER_nameDef} fell asleep halfway through a story. I sat up a while just listening to {OTHER_objective} breathe.

chronicle.li: {PAWN_nameDef} told {OTHER_nameDef} everything about the road, late into the night.
Home for good, {PAWN_nameDef} spent an evening telling {OTHER_nameDef} about the journey.

plain.li: [timeout] I've been away so long the colony feels like a story someone told me. I'll write about it when I'm closer to home.
[otherdead] They told me about {OTHER_nameDef} when I got back. I had a whole bag of things to tell {OTHER_objective}.
[otherleft] I got home and {OTHER_nameDef} was gone. Nobody could say where to.
Half of what I meant to tell {OTHER_nameDef} about the road, I've forgotten. It doesn't seem to matter now.

gloomy.li: [otherdead] I saved up the road for {OTHER_nameDef}, every mile of it. Now there's no one I want to tell.

warm.li: [timeout] I've so much to tell {OTHER_nameDef} when I'm back. I'm keeping it all safe.

blunt.li: [timeout] Still on the road. Still missing home.

cheerful.li: [timeout] The road goes on and on! I'm collecting stories for when I'm home.

cold.li: [timeout] The journey has run longer than planned. I'll report when I return.

fizzleChronicle.li: [otherdead] {PAWN_nameDef} came home to find {OTHER_nameDef} gone for good.
[otherleft] {PAWN_nameDef} came home, but {OTHER_nameDef} had left the colony.
[timeout] {PAWN_nameDef} has been away too long for the homecoming {PAWN_pronoun} imagined.
{PAWN_nameDef} never did tell {OTHER_nameDef} about the road.

plain.li: {OTHER_nameDef} was on {OTHER_possessive} way home. I keep looking down the road anyway.
{OTHER_nameDef} never made it back. I'd kept {OTHER_possessive} place at the table the whole time, and I'm keeping it a while longer.
[partner] I sleep on {OTHER_nameDef}'s side of the bed now. {OTHER_nameDef} was supposed to come home.

cold.li: {OTHER_nameDef} died short of home. I had prepared for a homecoming. Now I have to unprepare.

ColonyCouncil.ArcDef.label: somewhere to belong
ColonyCouncil.ArcDef.summary: A newcomer who doesn't feel at home yet finds a friendly face, a room of their own and, in time, a place among the others.

li.label: a stranger here
li.waiting: Next: someone makes {PAWN_nameDef} feel welcome. {OTHER_nameDef} might.

plain.li: Still don't know where anything is kept. I asked where the spare blankets were and three people pointed three different ways.
Everyone here has jokes I don't get yet. I laugh a beat late.
[night] Lay awake listening to the colony. Every noise is someone else's.
Ate supper at the end of the table. People were civil. That was all.
[child] I don't know where to sit at supper, and the big ones talk over my head.

warm.li: The people here are decent to me. I just don't know them yet, and they don't know me.

blunt.li: New place, new faces, new rules. I'll manage. I always do.

cheerful.li: Learned four names today! Only got one of them wrong.

gloomy.li: This isn't my home. It's a place I sleep. Maybe that'll change, but not soon.

cold.li: I am observing how this colony works. Who decides, who listens, who is listened to.

chronicle.li: {PAWN_nameDef} is still finding {PAWN_possessive} feet in the colony.
{PAWN_nameDef} hasn't quite settled in yet.

li.label: a place of my own
li.waiting: Next: a room of {PAWN_possessive} own, or at least some good days in a row.

plain.li: {OTHER_nameDef} showed me around today: the good well, the door that sticks, where the dog sleeps. It helped more than I'd have guessed.
{OTHER_nameDef} asked where I came from and listened to the answer.
Now that I know my way around, I'd like a corner of it that's mine. A door I can close.
[child] {OTHER_nameDef} showed me the best hiding places. I'm not telling anyone where they are.

warm.li: {OTHER_nameDef} took me under {OTHER_possessive} wing without making a fuss of it. I won't forget that.

blunt.li: {OTHER_nameDef} showed me around. Good. Now I need somewhere to sleep that isn't everyone's.

cheerful.li: {OTHER_nameDef} gave me the grand tour! I've already got a favorite spot to sit.

gloomy.li: {OTHER_nameDef} was kind to me today. I'm waiting to find out what it costs.

cold.li: {OTHER_nameDef} made the effort to orient me. Useful. A room of my own would be more useful still.

plain.li: Showed {OTHER_nameDef} around today. {OTHER_nameDef} asks good questions.
{OTHER_nameDef} reminds me of how I was when I first came here. Lost, and hiding it.

chronicle.li: {OTHER_nameDef} has been showing {PAWN_nameDef} around the colony.
{PAWN_nameDef} has found a friendly face in {OTHER_nameDef}.

li.label: putting down roots
li.waiting: Next: some good days, among people who are glad to have {PAWN_objective}.

plain.li: A space of my own. I've put my things out where I can see them and moved the bed twice.
Planted something in a pot by my door. If it grows, I'm staying.
Somebody asked my opinion at supper. I had one.
[child] I have a box for my things now, and nobody else is allowed in it.

warm.li: I've started saying "we" when I talk about the colony. I caught myself doing it today and didn't take it back.

blunt.li: Got my own space. Better. Still learning the rest.

cheerful.li: My corner has a bed, a shelf and a very ugly chair that I love!

gloomy.li: I've got a place of my own now. Let's see how long I get to keep it.

cold.li: A room, a role, and a few people who seem pleased to see me. Adequate foundations.

chronicle.li: {PAWN_nameDef} has started to put down roots.
{PAWN_nameDef} has a place of {PAWN_possessive} own in the colony now.

plain.li: Came in from the fields today and thought "home" without meaning to. So that's settled.
I know which step creaks, who snores and what everyone takes in their tea. I live here.
If anyone new ever turns up, I'll show them where the blankets are. I know now.
[child] This is my home. I told {OTHER_nameDef} so and {OTHER_pronoun} said "I know".

warm.li: This is home. I couldn't say exactly when it happened. {OTHER_nameDef} had a lot to do with it.

blunt.li: I live here. Simple as that.

cheerful.li: I'm one of the old faces now! Well, one of the slightly worn ones.

gloomy.li: It's home. That means it can be lost, but I'll take it.

cold.li: I have decided this colony is mine, as much as I am its.

plain.li: {OTHER_nameDef} has settled in. You'd think {OTHER_pronoun}'d been here for years.

chronicle.li: {PAWN_nameDef} calls the colony home now.
Whatever {PAWN_nameDef} left behind, {PAWN_possessive} home is here now.

plain.li: [timeout] I've been here a season and still feel like a guest. Maybe that's just how I am.
[otherdead] {OTHER_nameDef} was the first person here who made me feel welcome. Now {OTHER_nameDef} is dead and I'm a stranger again.
[otherleft] {OTHER_nameDef} has left. I'd only just started to feel at home, and {OTHER_nameDef} was half the reason.
I live here. I don't belong here yet. Those are different things.

warm.li: [timeout] Everyone's been kind. I just don't feel like I belong yet.

cheerful.li: [timeout] Not quite home yet, but I've learned where the good blankets are!

gloomy.li: [timeout] I keep waiting to feel at home. It hasn't come.

cold.li: [timeout] I live here. Belonging is a separate question, and the answer is not yet.

fizzleChronicle.li: [otherdead] With {OTHER_nameDef} gone, {PAWN_nameDef} feels like a stranger here again.
{PAWN_nameDef} still doesn't feel at home in the colony.

plain.li: {OTHER_nameDef} hadn't been here long. Long enough that I'd started to think of {OTHER_objective} as one of us.
I showed {OTHER_nameDef} where everything was. I wish we'd had longer for the rest.

cold.li: {OTHER_nameDef} died before {OTHER_pronoun} had properly settled in. A waste.

ColonyCouncil.ArcDef.label: a companion
ColonyCouncil.ArcDef.summary: An animal starts following its master about. Hours together, some training and a lot of patience later, the two of them may bond.

plain.li: {PET_nameDef} has taken to following me everywhere. To the fields, to the woodpile, to bed if I let {PET_objective}.
Every time I turn around, there's {PET_nameDef}, waiting to see what we're doing next.
[night] {PET_nameDef} slept outside my door last night. I said nothing and left a blanket out.

warm.li: {PET_nameDef} brought me a stick this morning and waited. I threw it. That's how it starts, I suppose.

blunt.li: {PET_nameDef} won't leave me alone. Fine. Stay, then.

cheerful.li: {PET_nameDef} has decided I'm the best person in the colony! {PET_nameDef} is right.

gloomy.li: {PET_nameDef} follows me around as if I'm worth following. I hope I don't let {PET_objective} down.

cold.li: {PET_nameDef} has chosen me. I don't know on what grounds.

chronicle.li: {PAWN_nameDef} and {PET_nameDef} have been inseparable lately.
Wherever {PAWN_nameDef} goes these days, {PET_nameDef} is close behind.

li.label: learning each other
li.waiting: Next: more handling and training with {PET_nameDef}.

plain.li: {PET_nameDef} knows the sound of my boots now. I know which noise means hungry and which means bored.
Taught {PET_nameDef} to wait at the gate. It took most of the afternoon and a lot of scraps.

warm.li: {PET_nameDef} leaned against my legs while I worked today. Just leaned there. I didn't want to move.

cheerful.li: {PET_nameDef} came when I called. Well, eventually!

gloomy.li: I'm getting attached to {PET_nameDef}. I know how that tends to end, with animals.

cold.li: {PET_nameDef} answers to me better than to anyone. I am more pleased by that than I expected.

chronicle.li: {PAWN_nameDef} has been spending long hours with {PET_nameDef}.

li.label: trust
li.waiting: Next: time enough for a real bond.

plain.li: {PET_nameDef} fell asleep with {PET_possessive} head on my foot while I ate. I finished my supper without moving.
[storm|rain] When the storm came, {PET_nameDef} came straight to me. Not to shelter. To me.
Took {PET_nameDef} out past the fields today, just the two of us. {PET_nameDef} didn't wander off once.

warm.li: I trust {PET_nameDef}, and {PET_nameDef} trusts me. You can't ask more than that of anyone.

cheerful.li: {PET_nameDef} has a spot by my bed now. It used to be my spot!

gloomy.li: {PET_nameDef} would follow me into a fire. I'll have to make sure I never walk into one.

cold.li: {PET_nameDef} is the one creature here I'm sure of.

chronicle.li: {PAWN_nameDef} and {PET_nameDef} trust each other now.

plain.li: {PET_nameDef} is my companion now, the kind you get once or twice in a life if you're lucky.
Somebody asked whose animal {PET_nameDef} was. I said nobody's. {PET_nameDef} looked at me as if I'd told a lie.
[child] {PET_nameDef} is my best friend. I'm allowed to have an animal for a best friend.

warm.li: {PET_nameDef} and I go everywhere together. I'm better company for it.

blunt.li: {PET_nameDef} and me. That's how it is.

cheerful.li: {PET_nameDef} and I are a team! A small, muddy team.

gloomy.li: Animals don't live as long as we do. I'll have every day with {PET_nameDef} I can.

cold.li: {PET_nameDef} needs me. From this one, I find I don't mind it.

chronicle.li: {PAWN_nameDef} and {PET_nameDef} go everywhere together now.
{PET_nameDef} has chosen {PAWN_nameDef}, and {PAWN_nameDef} has chosen back.

plain.li: [otherdead] {PET_nameDef} is dead. We'd only just started to understand each other.
[otherleft] {PET_nameDef} is gone. I keep looking down for {PET_objective} at my heels.
[timeout] {PET_nameDef} has lost interest in me and taken up with the cook. I can't blame {PET_objective}.
{PET_nameDef} and I never quite got there. Some animals keep to themselves.

warm.li: [timeout] {PET_nameDef} and I aren't there yet. I'll keep a treat in my pocket, just in case.

cheerful.li: [timeout] {PET_nameDef} prefers someone else for now, but I'm not giving up!

gloomy.li: [timeout] Even {PET_nameDef} would rather be somewhere else.

cold.li: [timeout] {PET_nameDef} hasn't taken to me. Some animals don't.

fizzleChronicle.li: [otherdead] {PET_nameDef} died before {PAWN_nameDef} and {PET_objective} had truly bonded.
{PAWN_nameDef} and {PET_nameDef} have gone their separate ways.

plain.li: {OTHER_nameDef}'s animal keeps waiting by the door. Someone will have to look after it now. I suppose that's me.
{OTHER_nameDef} had just found a friend in one of the animals. It still goes to the gate at dusk, looking for {OTHER_objective}.
